body.label: Effect
body.html: Burn 1 additional Action Die. On success, deal 2 Necrotic Damage and make the target Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn. Your own Movement is reduced by 1 for that duration.

surges.html: Move the target 1 unit sideways after a hit.
Deal +1 Damage if you currently have a Core Wound.

rider.title: Rite - Offering
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it deals Damage to you. Echo: impose -1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it before your next turn; neither side's Damage is undone.
